label: October 5–11, 2026
intro: Chinatown lights up for the Vegetarian Festival — plus chocolate, skating, and drums to round out a legendary week.
weekday_note: Midweek is great for the drum trial lesson at Rockademy, or a quieter science museum visit.

activities.title: Vegetarian Festival at Yaowarat (Chinatown)
activities.why: Colorful lanterns, street food stalls everywhere, red-and-gold decorations, and crowds in white. A wild sensory adventure for Thor — unlike anything else.
activities.tip: Go early evening around 5–6 PM before the crowds peak. Try the vegan coconut desserts. Keep Thor close — Yaowarat gets very busy.

activities.title: Bean to Bar Chocolate Making Workshop
activities.time: Various sessions — check and book online
activities.location: Bangkok (see booking platform for current venue)
activities.why: Hands-on chocolate making from scratch — Thor gets to taste every step. Perfect for his love of building and making.
activities.tip: Book via Tripadvisor or Viator. Check minimum age — usually 6, so call ahead to confirm they're flexible for a mature 5-year-old.

activities.title: Ice Skating at The Rink — Weekend
activities.location: The Rink, Central World (BTS Chit Lom)
activities.why: Thor's favourite way to move — glide around the ice with practice penguins for support.
activities.tip: Make it a Central World afternoon — skate, eat, maybe catch a movie.

activities.title: Drum Lesson Trial at Rockademy Thailand
activities.why: Thor is crazy about drums — this is the real deal. A proper drum kit, a real instructor, and a 30-minute intro that will blow his mind.
activities.tip: Call or message in advance to request a kids trial lesson. Mention his age so they prepare the right kit setup.

activities.title: National Science Museum Day Trip
activities.location: National Science Museum, Pathum Thani (~45 min from Bangkok)
activities.why: Massive hands-on science exhibits — Thor can build, experiment, and explore for a full day. Great for his building & making curiosity.
activities.tip: Get there early and take a Grab car. Bring a packed lunch — the on-site food options are limited.

activities.title: Kids Pottery at Aromdee Art Studio
activities.location: Aromdee Art Studio, near BTS Punnawithi
activities.why: Wheel throwing and hand building for age 5+ — messy, creative, and satisfying for Thor's maker instincts.
activities.tip: Located near BTS Punnawithi — easy to reach. Book via their Instagram page.
